counter_collection.scope: One warm-up and three measured stable-power captured-frame replays per frozen capture; separate from native application timings

comparison.scope: Separate captured-frame replay under RenderDoc stable power state; excluded from baseline statistics

all_primary_hit_draws.label: Primary hit draw list; wall-backup excluded

comparison.wrapper_note: Both per-capture and batch results completed successfully with healthy final device status before the wrapper stopped the still-running qrenderdoc process at its exit/cleanup timeout.

counter_collection.first_attempt: Windows canceled the original UAC request; retained cancellation log.

notes.graphics_span: First-to-last graphics-pass timestamp span, including queue gaps; not GPU busy time or FPS.
notes.cpu: RHI frame-to-frame period at timestamp collection, including waits; delayed GPU readbacks are not paired CPU/GPU frames. Zero means unavailable. Capture wall time is not CPU frame time.
notes.timings: 3x120 accepted frames per view after warm-up; inspector/screenshots/attachment readbacks disabled; RenderDoc replay separate
notes.baseline: Frozen prior native baseline on same PC; not re-run or overwritten. Small differences may include inter-session variation. New invocation counts come from a separate matched stable-power replay and must not replace the native timings.

validation_review.camera_path_description: 0.70m along upper-glancing forward vector, 29 steps and eight exact readback stops; face 308 crosses from depth 0.327 to near-plane contact.
